simple.summary: אָפַף (ʼâphaph) means to surround First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 5.

definitions.full: H661. aphaph אָפַף verb surround, encompass (Assyrian apâpu Zim BP 59 ) — Qal Perfect אָֽפְפוּ Psa 40:13 ; אְפָפוּנִי 18:5 +; — encompass (poetry) literal Jonah 2:6 (subject מַיִם ); figurative, subject evils & misfortunes רָעוֺת Psa 40:13 ; (followed by עָלַי ); מות מִשְׁבְּרֵי 2Sam 22:5 , compare מ ׳חֶבְלֵי Psa 18:5 , also 116:3 .
